template.name: Long-Leg Doji Breakout
template.entry_long: close > donchian_high_prev(high, {p0}) and high - low > {p0} * atr(high, low, close, {p1})
template.notes: The doji high is approximated by the prior bar high so the long breakout is a fresh one-bar high, and the documented ATR filter (ATR 14, multiplier 0.5) becomes a volatility-expansion test. Docs state no stops, and the exit is the documented SMA(20) cross.
